info.name: Ticketing Platform
info.description:
Basic requests for the Ticketing Platform API.

Start the local stack with `docker compose up --build -d` and run the collection. Dates are generated relative to the current date, so the requests never expire.

item.name: Create event - validation errors
item.description: Each request breaks one rule and checks the error code returned by the API.

request.description: Capacity must be greater than zero.

response.name: Invalid capacity

originalRequest.description: Capacity must be greater than zero.

response.body:
{
  "detail": "capacity must be greater than zero but was 0",
  "instance": "/api/v1/events",
  "status": 400,
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "code": "INVALID_EVENT_CAPACITY"
}

request.description: A new event cannot start in the past.

response.name: Starts in the past

originalRequest.description: A new event cannot start in the past.

response.body:
{
  "detail": "startsAt must be in the future but was 2026-09-10T04:16:11Z",
  "instance": "/api/v1/events",
  "status": 400,
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "code": "EVENT_STARTS_IN_THE_PAST"
}

response.name: Finishes before it starts
response.body:
{
  "detail": "startsAt and finishesAt are required and finishesAt must be after startsAt",
  "instance": "/api/v1/events",
  "status": 400,
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "code": "INVALID_EVENT_SCHEDULE"
}

response.name: Blank name
response.body:
{
  "detail": "name must not be blank and must have at most 200 characters",
  "instance": "/api/v1/events",
  "status": 400,
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "code": "INVALID_EVENT_NAME"
}

response.name: Blank venue

}
